sentence: They are very good with bows and arrows in the archery contest.
synonym: skilled at using bows and arrows
synonymNote: 两者都表示在弓箭方面非常擅长，意思相同。

distractors.word: they enjoy collecting bows and arrows

distractors.word: they often carry bows and arrows
distractors.note: 经常携带弓箭不代表他们技术好。

distractors.word: they know about bows and arrows
distractors.note: 了解弓箭知识不等同于擅长使用它们。
